releaseNotes: Thank-you send now asks you to confirm before it counts as sent, uses the right Call vs WhatsApp numbers, and fixes review analytics.
features: Mark as sent confirm before logging thank-you / wish shares
Call and WhatsApp use separate numbers on enquiry details
bugFixes: No more false thank-you sent when WhatsApp opens the wrong chat
Footer WhatsApp uses the WhatsApp number
Reviews figure counts by ask/received date, not booking date
